test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Advances in satellite imaging

P. across diverse geographic regions

Q. enabling accurate climate modelling

R. and disaster prediction systems

S. have transformed environmental monitoring,
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **SQRP**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The sentence begins with part **(S)** as it introduces the subject, "Advances in satellite imaging have transformed environmental monitoring."
 
• The next part **(Q)** logically continues the sentence with "enabling accurate climate modelling," describing the purpose of these advances.
 
• Part **(R)** follows next with "and disaster prediction systems," adding further details about the applications of the advances.
 
• Finally, part **(P)** completes the sentence with "across diverse geographic regions," explaining the scope of these applications.

Therefore, the correct answer is **SQRP.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 2 (PRQS):** This option starts with "across diverse geographic regions enabling accurate climate modelling," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3 (QPSR):** This option starts with "enabling accurate climate modelling across diverse geographic regions," which does not set the context properly as it skips the subject.
 
• **Option 4 (RPSQ):** This option starts with "and disaster prediction systems across diverse geographic regions," which is incomplete and grammatically incorrect as the subject is missing.
